description: This file defines data structures and function prototypes for traversing and inspecting trees in a version control system, likely Git. It includes structures for tree entries, tree descriptors, traversal info, and functions for initializing, updating, and walking through tree objects.

methods.name: tree_entry_extract
methods.description: Decodes the current tree entry and returns its object ID, while setting the path and mode pointers.

methods.name: update_tree_entry
methods.description: Advances to the next entry in a tree descriptor.

methods.name: update_tree_entry_gently
methods.description: Gently updates to the next tree entry, warning on corrupt entries.

methods.name: init_tree_desc
methods.description: Initializes a tree descriptor with a given tree object ID, buffer, and size.

methods.name: init_tree_desc_gently
methods.description: Gently initializes a tree descriptor, warning on corrupt entries.

methods.name: tree_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the next tree entry, indicating if more entries remain.

methods.name: tree_entry_gently
methods.description: Gently retrieves the next tree entry, warning on corrupt entries.

methods.name: fill_tree_descriptor
methods.description: Initializes a tree descriptor from a tree object ID.

methods.name: traverse_trees
methods.description: Traverses multiple trees in parallel, calling a callback for each entry.

methods.name: get_tree_entry_follow_symlinks
methods.description: Retrieves a tree entry following symlinks, returning object ID and mode.

methods.name: make_traverse_path
methods.description: Generates the full path of a tree entry based on traversal info.

methods.name: strbuf_make_traverse_path
methods.description: Creates a traverse path string into a strbuf.

methods.name: setup_traverse_info
methods.description: Initializes traversal info with a starting path.

methods.name: traverse_path_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of a traverse path.

methods.name: tree_entry_interesting
methods.description: Determines if a tree entry is interesting based on the index state and pathspec.
